content.title: Intel, Paramount are some of Wall Street's best comebacks of 2025
content.description:

Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre, who also hosts Yahoo Finance's Stocks in Translation podcast, takes a closer look at some of 2025's best comebacks.
